name: Three Bean Confetti Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (15 oz) red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (12 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (8¾ oz) whole kernel corn, drained
1 can (14½ oz) diced tomatoes with roasted garlic, undrained
½ cup fat-free Italian salad dressing

steps: In a bowl, mix together beans, corn, tomatoes, Italian salad dressing, Italian seasoning and pepper.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
